description: Permissions for the main window. Keep this list minimal: the frontend does all filesystem, shell, and dialog work through purpose-built #[tauri::command] handlers (fs.rs, julia.rs, pty.rs), not through the corresponding Tauri plugins. Granting shell:allow-execute or the fs:allow-* set here would hand arbitrary command execution and arbitrary file access to anything running in the webview for no functional benefit. The dialog plugin is driven from Rust only (fs.rs, via DialogExt), which needs no ACL entry. The one addition to core:default is set-webview-zoom, which View > Zoom In needs and which core:webview:default does not include; it can only rescale the window it is already rendering in, and the value it is given is clamped in settings.rs.
